_doc: Words a display name may not contain (spec §3.1). A STARTING LIST: extend it freely; the server reads it at start.
Read by apps/server/src/accounts/blockedWords.ts, which compares names and words in a folded form:
lower case, without niqqud or accents, Hebrew final letters as regular ones (ך→כ, ם→מ, ן→נ, ף→פ, ץ→צ),
common leetspeak read as letters (0→o, 1→i or l, 3→e, 4→a, 5→s, 7→t, 8→b, 9→g, @→a, $→s),
separators ignored (f.u_c.k), and a letter repeated any number of times (fuuuck).
- substring: blocked anywhere in the name. Only words that hardly ever hide inside an innocent word.
- exact: blocked only as a whole word of the name (the whole name, or a part split by _ . digits,
a change of case (BigDick) or of script). For short or common words that live inside innocent ones:
ass (class), anal (canal), cock (peacock), rapist (therapist), חרא (אחראי), ערס (ערסל), כוס (a cup).
- reserved: names that pose as the game or its staff, in the same two kinds.
- allow: innocent words that contain a substring word (Shitrit, a surname); masked before matching.
Write words in plain letters (no spaces, digits or punctuation); the matcher refuses to start otherwise.
Never list words that only name an identity (gay, jew, arab, homo...): people may use them for themselves.
